description: FERC Form 1 sales for resale (Schedule 310) for one utility and report year, 1994 to date: each purchaser (buyer), statistical classification (RQ, LF, IF, SF, LU, OS, AD), MWh sold and revenue dollars. Rows sorted by MWh, subtotal and total rows excluded and reported separately. Answers "who bought the most power for resale from LG&E in 1994". Source: FERC Form 1 as processed by Catalyst Cooperative PUDL.

classification.description: Optional statistical classification code filter, e.g. SF, LF, OS, RQ.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

name: ferc1_sales_for_resale
title: Ferc1 Sales For Resale
